title: Ch’alla manqhankir Primavera
intro: Quran anales ukanx mä jach’a paciencia uñacht’ayir jaqix mä yant’äwimpiw uñjasiwayi, ukax wali ch’amani chuymanakaruw p’akintaspa. Taqi kunas apsutäxänwa - qamirïña, familia, ukat k’umaräña. Ukampis chuyma chʼallxtataw mä altʼat chuymampi mayisïwix jan suytʼat istʼasïna. ¿Aka almarux uñt’asmati, khititix wasitat utt’ayat sarnaqäwipax walja maranakaw ist’asi?
clues: Mä yantʼampiw yantʼapjjetäna, ukajj wali jachʼapuniwa, ukat walja maranakaw uka yantʼajj amtasi.
Taqi kunatix wakiskirïki ukanak chhaqhayawayta - qamir kankaña, wawanakaja, ukat k’umaräña.
Cuerpojajj wali tʼaqesiñ usutänwa, taqeniw nayat jitheqtapjjetäna.
Jan chʼamanïtajatjja, Supayajj jan waltʼäwinakampi tʼaqhesiñampiw llamktʼitu sasaw Diosar jawsayäta.
Allah jupax jaysawayitu ukat kayujampiw aka uraqir jawq’jañajatak kamachi.
Uka chiqatpachaw mä thaya phuch’ux mistüna, ukatx Allah jupax familiajaruw wasitat utt’ayäna ukat khuyapayasiñjam pä kutiw jiltayawayitu.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
